decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out several accessories like cases and charging cables to focus on actual Bluetooth speakers. My consideration set includes a range of products from budget to premium. The JBL Charge 5 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_120) is the clear standout due to its 4.8 rating and massive review count, suggesting it is a highly reliable and high-performing speaker. While the DOSS (prod_bluetooth_speakers_008) and Raymate (prod_bluetooth_speakers_153) offer great value, the JBL's superior build quality and recognized brand reputation for 'Pro Sound' make it the most attractive purchase for a long-term investment.
